notes: Default level PRL3 (daily-capable); VC-UXD-54 is PRL1 (harness prerequisite). Grades: A primary source / closed form / measured; target = budget set by this spec; B/C never gate. Sources: validation/sources.md. Electron cases run on the pack 06 harness (act.* with declared commands, observe.commands, perf.measure); field cases import pilot timings (pack 01); perf cases run on the pack 03 perf runner. 'baseline' = state of origin/main f1351cff read on 2026-10-28 (code audit M2 or fixture run M1).
